Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s result that Big Jim McLain had two producers (Robert M. Fellows and John Wayne), incorrectly singled out Robert M. Fellows as “the producer,” and then provided an unrelated role (Robert Duvall as Ned Pepper). The task required linking the producer who also acted in True Grit (John Wayne) to his role (Rooster Cogburn). This is a misattribution and premature task completion without proper cross-referencing.
